Select: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source: molecule_dictionary (parent), molecule_hierarchy, molecule_dictionary (child), compound_records, compound_structures, activities, docs, assays, target_dictionary. Join: parent.molregno = hierarchy.parent_molregno, child.molregno = hierarchy.molregno, child.molregno = records.molregno, records.record_id = activities.record_id, records.doc_id = docs.doc_id, activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id, activities.tid = target_dictionary.tid, child.molregno = structures.molregno. Filter: parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1336', target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL279', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_units = 'nM'. Sort: compound_chembl_id ASC, compound_key ASC, pubmed_id_or_doi ASC, assay_description ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC, target_chembl_id ASC, target_name ASC, target_organism ASC. Limit: None.
